name: INSEE — Fichier des prénoms depuis 1900
copyright: Copyright Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques (INSEE)
note: Every given name registered in France since 1900, with the number of people who bear
it. Real frequencies, from the office that records the births -- the same class of
source as the US Census surnames, and the same reason for using it: names are
Zipf-distributed and a uniform draw produces data that is wrong in exactly the way
that matters for deduplication and analytics work.
Licence Ouverte 2.0, France's open-data licence. Attribution only, commercial use
permitted, and explicitly declared compatible by Etalab with CC BY 4.0 -- which is
already in this corpus for GeoNames. It composes with Apache-2.0.
The licence is not stated on the INSEE download page, which is why it is recorded here
from data.gouv.fr's catalogue entry for the same dataset, where INSEE declares it as
`lov2`. A licence found only by asking the right registry is still a stated licence;
an unstated one would have been a reason to walk away, as it was for GLEIF's entity
France publishes given names openly and surnames only commercially. That asymmetry is
common -- birth registers are public record and family-name frequencies usually are
not -- so `person.last_name` in `fr` stays on faker until a source appears.
